news.title: Sagility block deal: Promoter Sagility BV likely to sell 12% stake for Rs 2,377 crore
news.summary: Sagility promoter Sagility B.V. is reportedly planning a 12% stake sale worth ₹2,377 crore through a block deal. The healthcare IT services firm posted 22.5% revenue growth and 8.1% adjusted profit growth in Q2 FY27.

news.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
news.summary: Indian equities rallied over 1% on Thursday as the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, crude prices eased and institutional buying strengthened sentiment. Sensex gained 905 points, while Nifty rose 238 points, adding nearly ₹5 lakh crore in market value.

news.title: Market Trading Guide: Eternal among 2 stocks to buy for Friday for healthy returns
news.summary: Indian stocks rallied after the US Federal Reserve held rates steady, easing crude prices and renewed institutional buying lifted sentiment. Technical analysts identified Adani Ports and Eternal as potential Friday trading opportunities, citing bullish momentum, breakout levels and defined targets.

news.title: Ambuja Cements’ profit slumps 90% on higher costs, high previous-year base
news.summary: Ambuja Cements reported a 90% year-on-year profit decline to ₹236 crore in Q2 FY27 as rising fuel, logistics and operating costs squeezed margins. Revenue remained flat at ₹9,197 crore, while EBITDA fell 28%, prompting renewed cost-control efforts.

news.title: Milky Mist Q2 revenue surges 42% YoY, EBITDA soars 54%
news.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food recorded 41.6% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2 FY27, achieving record quarterly revenue and gross profit. Strong demand for value-added dairy, protein products and yoghurt drove growth, while first-half profit after tax surged 308.4%.

news.title: Brigade Group reports 29% growth in Q2 net profit at Rs 219 crore
news.summary: Brigade Group reported a 29% year-on-year profit increase to ₹219 crore in Q2 FY27, despite lower revenue. Strong residential bookings, higher operating profit, robust leasing performance and hospitality growth supported earnings, while new project launches strengthened its development pipeline.
